events.author: Velociryx
events.name: A Brush With Death

options.text: The injury has instilled a new sense of discipline in [character].
Since the injury, [character] has become more circumspect and, frankly, wiser.

events.text: [character] was badly wounded during a recent battle. He will live, but the wound has left its mark.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: An Ignominious Wound

options.text: [character] bears the wound with pride, and good naturedly, even sharing in the jokes about it.
[character] grumbles incessantly about it, but continues to lead with honor, and more courageously than ever.

events.text: [character] is in the habit of leading from the front, which is brave, but at times, perhaps a bit unwise. In a recent battle as he turned to shout orders to those under his command, he was struck in the back of the thigh and badly wounded. Sadly, the wound was not the only injury. Though the wound was clearly on the upper portion of the back of his thigh, it was near enough to his buttocks that “hit in the butt” was listed as the formal description of the wound in battle reports.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Facial Wound

options.text: Build a monument to dignify his sacrifice.
Valor is its own reward.

events.text: In the heat of battle, [character] sustained a terrible wound. It has left a visible scar, marking him forever. Thankfully it was not life threatening, but it will be the talk of the court for some time.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Fangs of Our Foes

options.text: Spare no expense! If it is within our power to save [character], we must do so.
Sadly, his fate is in the hands of the gods.

events.text: In a recent battle, our cowardly foes got a lucky shot, grazing [character]. Unfortunately, a grazing wound was enough, as the tip of the arrow he was struck with was dipped in poison!

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Hard Rain

options.text: By all means! It is important to recognize and reward valor any time it is displayed. Let us feast!
I think not. He merely did what we would expect any of our commanders to do.

events.text: In a recent battle made more chaotic by a sudden, unexpected thunderstorm, [character] was badly injured by a volley of enemy fire. Despite this injury, he continued to fight valiantly. Many in your Court were impressed by his bravery and have suggested a great feast in his honor.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Hero of the Realm

options.text: Spare no expense! Rush our finest healers to his side!
His fate is in the hands of the Gods now.

events.text: In a recent battle, [character] was struck by a blow that would have killed a lesser man. Our healers did what they could, but fever has set in, and none know if he will live.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Poisoned Tips

options.text: The resourceful General will undoubtedly make an antidote!
Have his troops rest after their ordeal.
Suggest he gets ready for a counter-attack.
The [unit] should adapt the poison for their own weapons.

events.text: As his troops are suppressed by the onslaught of missiles, [character] notices that even those grazed by the enemy projectiles are soon unmoving on the ground. Poison! Cursing the foul tactics of the [rival] ranged units, [character] has withdrawn to plan his next move.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Rain of Arrows

options.text: Force [character] into retirement.
Allow him to return to command his [unit].

events.text: News arrives that [character] has been grievously injured by the onslaught of [rival] arrows. Struck no less than five times, the General still lives through some act of divine grace or incredible luck. Rumor spreads through [rival] of the General’s resilience. They say that it was [character] own sheer will that kept him alive, that he continued to fight even while studded with arrows. [character] is eager to return to his troops, although your advisers suggest that the General’s new found fame could be put to good use as the Governor of a city instead.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Shattered Shield

tip: As leader: +5% Unit Trait Modifier / Ranged
As general: +10% Unit Trait Modifier / Ranged

options.text: Allow him to train with your officers.
Counter with ranged units of your own.
Strong formations are needed to survive such ranged attacks.

events.text: Caught in the thick of the fighting, [character] has been left with vicious wounds after his shield shattered under the unrelenting rain of projectiles from the [rival] forces. [character] is determined to spend time improving the state of your armies’ protection against such tactics while recovering from his wounds.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Stronger For It

options.text: [character] invented a spate of colorful curses while recovering and uses them to taunt our enemies.
[character] is tougher now than ever.

events.text: A recent sharp skirmish saw [character] grievously wounded. He recovered, but the wound left its mark. It had other impacts besides...

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The People’s Shield

options.text: [character] is a hero to his troops and all of [rival].
[character] has higher duties as a general. He needs to stay alive.

events.text: Word is spreading of [character] heroics after the General threw himself in front of another soldier when their unit was suddenly attacked by [rival] ranged forces, shielding the soldier from the incoming projectiles. The soldier’s life was saved, but [character] armor was shredded by a number of blows. The army sees [character] as a hero, but the court wonder if you will reward such reckless behavior.
